newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO cuts local stainless steel prices.
newsitem.headline: POSCO cuts local stainless steel prices.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) said on Friday it has cut prices for its sales of stainless steel products to local export manufacturers.
The price cut, which would affect stainless steel plates, stainless wire-rods, stainless cold-rolled steel plates, was aimed at boosting domestic demand and helping exporters fighting rising costs.
A POSCO statement said the reduced prices would apply from January contracts.
POSCO gave the price changes in terms of average prices in the first quarter versus the fourth quarter in 1996.
Prices for stainless wire-rods were cut by $50 a tonne to $1,365 from $1,415 and stainless plate prices by $120 a tonne to $1,410 from $1,530, the statement said.
Prices for stainless cold-rolled steel plates were cut by $160 a tonne to $1,795 from $1,955.
But an official at POSCO's public relations department said its export prices were not affected.
Last October, POSCO cut its domestic supply prices for major stainless steel items.
